'''Nesta Term''' was a self-proclaimed Lens of the [[Central Isopter]], a [[death]] worshipping [[Religion|cult]] active during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. [[Gender|Her]] obsession with oblivion brought her and her fellow cultists to dangerous places, such as [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]], where they were said to study the harmonies of discord.<ref name="UVG" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> she and two other members of the cult stood together in one of the streets of Jedha [[City]] as the [[RA-7 protocol droid]] [[KMD-RA-71]] and the [[Vobati]] [[Forger (profession)|forger]] [[Valwid Ined]] walked past.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Term, as a part of her beliefs, wished for [[death]]. She was granted her wish when Jedha City was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> She wore a [[Color|brown]] and yellow patterned [[Clothing|mask]] and [[robe]] matching those worn by her fellow cult members.<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nesta Term first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Rogue One" /> and was first identified in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="UVG" />
